output.explanation: "Earns the most" asks about a sales rep's own pay (salary, commission or bonus). None of the listed tables has compensation data: marts.dim_sales_reps only has sales_rep_id, region and hire_date. Pay would also be confidential personal data. An answerable alternative is "Which sales rep brings in the most net revenue?", which would sum marts.fct_orders.net_revenue by sales_rep_id, counting only orders where is_revenue is true.
